Our staff picnic in pictures

Every winter the warehouse team closes early on a Saturday and heads out to the lake for an afternoon of cricket, food and an argument about who packed the ice. This year forty three people came along, including eleven from the night shift who normally never meet the day crew at all.

The cricket was won by the returns desk, which nobody expected, and the cooking was handled by a rotating group of volunteers who started before sunrise. Photographs from the day are pinned on the noticeboard in the canteen for anyone who wants a copy printed.
